snapshot.text: Universal Health Care law (2019) with PhilHealth as national insurer, but households still pay about 60% of health costs themselves. A new health secretary took over in July 2026; expanding PhilHealth benefits and zero balance billing in public hospitals are current themes.

priorities.title: Zero balance billing
priorities.text: Zero balance billing in public hospitals is meant to remove the need for political guarantee letters.

priorities.title: PhilHealth benefits for the middle class
priorities.text: PhilHealth is expanding benefits for middle-income members.
